correctness.rationale: Constructed independently the 32-state nondeterministic bitwise addition machine (carry, last bits of each summand, and two adjacent-11 parities) and its subset determinization. Compared its acceptance for (0,0),(0,1),(1,1) against a separately saturated base-2 value automaton for the explicit exceptions. Exhaustive BFS reached precisely 88 product states, testing both binary transitions and the complement predicate on every reached state for each pair. The transition invariant inductively identifies paths with all possible two-summand representations; 88-state exhaustive reachability therefore proves every nonnegative target, not merely a finite range. Acceptance at zero and repeated summands is correctly handled.
residual_risks: Only ordinary binary overlapping-11 parity, two summands with repetition allowed, nonnegative targets; no representation multiplicity formula.
